business_problem: Farmers State Bank needed to connect fragmented website, phone, and branch interactions because customers expected digital-first convenience while the bank still needed to preserve the personal relationships central to community banking.
solution_summary: Farmers State Bank partnered with Incede.ai to deploy Penny, a digital front door powered by IBM watsonx Orchestrate. Instead of functioning as a simple FAQ chatbot, Penny uses multi-step orchestration to understand intent, guide customers through complete tasks, and connect them to the right banker or service. The assistant can schedule appointments, request callbacks, identify the correct branch, and extend conversations beyond the website through links to scheduling systems, internal tools, and SMS messaging. IBM watsonx Orchestrate also brings enterprise-grade auditability, logging, and governance controls that fit a regulated banking environment, so the experience can be both convenient and compliant. Because the interaction model was co-designed around FSB's service philosophy, Penny became a channel-connecting workflow layer rather than a generic overlay, helping the bank unify customer journeys while leaving staff more time for higher-value relationship work.
